purpose: Pre-2015 history for the M13/M14 volatility models (GARCH fits, FHS residual windows, regime threshold). Spliced onto the frozen data/research/SPY_prices.csv in return space; see docs/design_m13.md section 3.
source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance, auto_adjust=True (dividends and splits)
command: uv run --isolated --python 3.11 --extra research python -m research.download_data --start 2000-01-01 --end 2025-12-31 --output data/research/SPY_prices_2000_2025.csv
precision: Yahoo delivers these adjusted prices at single precision. 85% of the prices are exactly representable in float32, whose relative spacing at these price levels is 7.6e-8 to 1.0e-7, and every new dividend re-adjusts and re-rounds the whole history. Two downloads therefore disagree by about 1e-7 relative on prices and by up to about 1e-6 on log returns. No figure derived from this file is more precise than that, whatever precision it is printed with.

overlap_check.criterion: max |log-return difference| <= 2e-6 and every price ratio (extended / frozen) within 2e-6 of its median; adopted at G1 (G1-1) in place of 1e-10, which single-precision prices cannot meet

splice: Returns dated on or before 2015-01-02 come from this file; returns from 2015-01-05 on come from the frozen file, so every out-of-sample return is bit-identical to the published baseline's.
